THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The trip book

As you record, the four boxes fill in. Use all four to write one change for tonight.

WHAT PEOPLE SAIDStop 1
WHO IS COMINGStop 2
THE ART RULEStop 3

WHAT HAPPENEDWHAT TO DO

THE SCENE

Your class built a tower of old TVs that play your videos. You take the tower by bus to a new town each week. You write in the trip book. Tonight is the final art show. You need to write one change that makes it better. Four people each can help you.

THE HISTORY

This show is about Nam June Paik, an artist from Korea. He studied music in Japan and Germany. He mixed music and TV into a new kind of art. In 1988 he built a tower of 1,003 TVs.
